"""
Project Title: Neural Turing Machine for Sequence Copy Task (ai-ml-ds-NTMCopy2025)
File Name: neural_turing_machine_copy.py

Short Description:
Implements a Neural Turing Machine (NTM) in Keras: an LSTM controller augmented with an external memory matrix,
with differentiable read/write heads. Trained on the copy task: given a random binary sequence, reproduce it.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore

# ----------------------------
# Hyperparameters
# ----------------------------
SEQ_LEN: int = 20           # type: int = sequence length
BATCH_SIZE: int = 16        # type: int = batch size
INPUT_DIM: int = 8          # type: int = width of one-hot vector
CONTROLLER_UNITS: int = 100 # type: int = LSTM units
MEMORY_SLOTS: int = 128     # type: int = number of memory rows
MEMORY_WIDTH: int = 20      # type: int = number of memory columns
NUM_HEADS: int = 1          # type: int = number of read/write heads
EPOCHS: int = 100           # type: int = training epochs
LR: float = 1e-3            # type: float = learning rate
LOG_DIR: str = "./ntm_logs"
os.makedirs(LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ----------------------------
# Utility: Cosine similarity addressing
# ----------------------------
def cosine_similarity(key: tf.Tensor, M: tf.Tensor):
    # key: (B,1,W), M: (B,N,W) -> weights: (B,N)
    key = tf.nn.l2_normalize(key, -1)
    M_norm = tf.nn.l2_normalize(M, -1)
    sim = tf.matmul(M_norm, key, transpose_b=True)[...,0]  # (B,N)
    return sim

# ----------------------------
# NTM Layer
# ----------------------------
class NTMLayer(layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Controller
        self.controller = layers.LSTMCell(CONTROLLER_UNITS)
        # Output projection
        self.out_dense = layers.Dense(INPUT_DIM, activation="softmax")
        # Interface weights
        # For write: erase vector + add vector + key + beta
        self.interface_size = NUM_HEADS*(MEMORY_WIDTH + MEMORY_WIDTH + MEMORY_WIDTH + 1)
        self.interface_dense = layers.Dense(self.interface_size)
    def build(self, input_shape):
        # Initialize memory
        self.M = self.add_weight("memory", shape=(MEMORY_SLOTS, MEMORY_WIDTH),
                                 initializer=tf.keras.initializers.RandomNormal(0,0.1), trainable=False)
    def call(self, inputs, states):
        # inputs: (B,INPUT_DIM), states: ([h,c], read_vector)
        (h, c), read_prev = states
        # Controller update
        controller_input = tf.concat([inputs, read_prev], axis=1)
        h_new, [h_new, c_new] = self.controller(controller_input, [h, c])
        # Interface parameters
        iface = self.interface_dense(h_new)  # (B, interface_size)
        # Unpack interface
        iface = tf.reshape(iface, (-1, NUM_HEADS, MEMORY_WIDTH*3+1))
        k, erase, add, beta = tf.split(iface, 
            [MEMORY_WIDTH, MEMORY_WIDTH, MEMORY_WIDTH,1], axis=2)
        # Read/Write (one head)
        # Write
        w_sim = cosine_similarity(k[:,0:1,:], tf.tile(self.M[None,...], [tf.shape(inputs)[0],1,1]))
        w = tf.nn.softmax(beta[:,0,0:1]*w_sim, axis=1)[...,None]  # (B,N,1)
        e = tf.nn.sigmoid(erase[:,0,:])[:,None,:]  # (B,1,W)
        a = add[:,0,:][:,None,:]                  # (B,1,W)
        self.M.assign(self.M[None,:,:] * (1 - w*e) + w*a)  # update memory
        # Read
        w_sim_r = cosine_similarity(k[:,0:1,:], tf.tile(self.M[None,...], [tf.shape(inputs)[0],1,1]))
        w_r = tf.nn.softmax(beta[:,0,0:1]*w_sim_r, axis=1)[...,None]  # (B,N,1)
        read = tf.reduce_sum(self.M[None,...] * w_r, axis=1)  # (B,W)
        # Output
        output = self.out_dense(tf.concat([h_new, read], axis=1))
        return output, ([h_new, c_new], read)

# ----------------------------
# Build NTM Model
# ----------------------------
# Inputs: sequence of one-hot vectors plus delimiter at end
inp = Input((SEQ_LEN+1, INPUT_DIM))
ntm = NTMLayer()
# Initial states
h0 = tf.zeros((BATCH_SIZE, CONTROLLER_UNITS))
c0 = tf.zeros((BATCH_SIZE, CONTROLLER_UNITS))
read0 = tf.zeros((BATCH_SIZE, MEMORY_WIDTH))
states = ([h0, c0], read0)
outputs = []
# Unroll
for t in range(SEQ_LEN+1):
    out, states = ntm(inp[:,t,:], states)
    outputs.append(out)
# We only care about outputs after delimiter: last SEQ_LEN steps
outs = tf.stack(outputs[-(SEQ_LEN+1):-1], axis=1)  # (B,SEQ_LEN,INPUT_DIM)
model = Model(inp, outs)
model.compile(optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR), loss="categorical_crossentropy", metrics=["accuracy"])
print(model.summary())

# ----------------------------
# Data: Copy Task Generator
# ----------------------------
def gen_copy_batch(batch=BATCH_SIZE):
    seq = np.random.randint(0,2,size=(batch,SEQ_LEN,INPUT_DIM)).astype("float32")
    # delimiter: one-hot vector of all ones
    delim = np.ones((batch,1,INPUT_DIM),dtype="float32")
    inp_seq = np.concatenate([seq, delim], axis=1)
    target = seq
    return inp_seq, target

# ----------------------------
# Training
# ----------------------------
for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS+1):
    x_batch, y_batch = gen_copy_batch()
    loss, acc = model.train_on_batch(x_batch, y_batch)
    if epoch % 10 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS} - Loss: {loss:.4f}, Acc: {acc:.4f}")

# ----------------------------
# Example Use Cases
# ----------------------------
x_test, y_test = gen_copy_batch(4)
y_pred = model.predict(x_test)
print("Input[0]:", np.argmax(x_test[0,:SEQ_LEN],axis=1))
print("Pred[0]:", np.argmax(y_pred[0],axis=1))
print("True[0]:", np.argmax(y_test[0],axis=1))

Key Learnings & Research Areas:

  • Differentiable external memory with read/write heads.
  • LSTM controller interacting with memory via cosine addressing.
  • Sequence processing beyond RNNs, enabling algorithmic tasks.
  • Applications: algorithm learning, program induction, complex sequential reasoning.
